title: 共密 (Gongmi): 9 numeric telegrams of Huang Xing's circle, Tokyo <-> Shanghai, 10 June - 2 July 1916 (JACAR) — read in part

plaintext.source: No decipherment on the copies; the texts are not in Hsueh Chun-tu's edition of Huang Xing's 1916 drafts (黃興等電稿) nor found online.

transcription.source: JACAR scans; transcribed with Claude (first trials with Codex), every digit re-read blind by Brice Dudout
transcription.notes: Clear prefix 0364 1378 left out of the count. V4E includes framing repairs deduced from the decoding.

system.summary: The Chinese telegraph code (明密 book) with its pages, columns and rows renumbered by hand for the 共密 correspondent (S. Tomokiyo); equivalently key C51 (candidate) as a formula (key.md).
system.notes: Digits written in kanji numerals in a grid, read in columns right to left; the first two groups are a clear prefix naming the code book. One key, one entry: split from targets/numeric1916, as its NOTES propose.

prior_solution.where: None known: not in Hsueh Chun-tu's edition of Huang Xing's 1916 drafts (nothing between 8 and 20 June), nor online (Wenmi, Juin 1916 article). 黃興集 and Li Yuanhong's correspondence not yet checked.

conditions.human_role: Brice Dudout read the digits on the JACAR scans (blind re-reading), proposed the reading order of the grids, chose leads and criteria; Claude wrote the solvers, tests and log, proposed hypotheses, readings and translations; Codex made early trials.
models: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), agents run by Brice Dudout

solution.what: Forms read in columns right to left, four-digit groups; every digit re-read blind by Brice Dudout (20 groups of N30-N35 corrected on the scans).
For each of the 10,000 constants K the optimal tens permutation by exact assignment, scored by a CTC unigram/bigram model (first trials by Codex); K = 9000 and φ = 9761405283.
N07, under the same clear prefix 共密, does not read under C51 (another copy of the book or a faulty stream).

Contributor (Wenmi verify.py): the key reproduces every published raw text from the re-read digits; score far above 200 random keys of the same form and 200 digit shuffles. Rerun independently in targets/numeric1916 (20 Oct 2026).
S. Tomokiyo (Cryptiana): the 共密 key is a 明密 code book with pages, columns and rows renumbered by hand; the contributor checked the exact factorisation over all group values (mingmi.py).
Readings and translations as on the Wenmi page; counted by Daniel's rule: 510 certain, 24 probable, 21 unresolved or illegible of 555.

outcome.method_basis: Key search scored with a telegraph-code language model, without cribs or plaintext; only the form dates served as checks (key.md, NOTES.md).
outcome.fraction_read_source: Daniel's rule on reading.md: 510 certain + 24 probable of 555 groups (21 unresolved).

gaps.item: 21 characters unresolved or illegible (24 more read as probable)
gaps.detail: One-digit uncertainties on the police copies (the clerk's 一/二/三), anomalous codes, names and date codes; marked in reading.md.

credits.note: 共密: digits re-read on the JACAR scans, key C51 (candidate) recovered with Claude (Opus 5.5), readings, translations and context; read in part (partial critical edition)
the 共密 key read as a renumbered 明密 code book (pages, columns and rows rewritten by hand), shown on a June 1916 edition of the 明密碼電報書; credited on the Wenmi page

texts.label: 共密 (Gongmi), 9 telegrams, 10 June - 2 July 1916
texts.summary: Huang Xing's five conditions to Li Yuanhong (restore the 1912 Provisional Constitution and the old Parliament, no amnesty, Duan's cabinet to resign, move Wang Zhanyuan, bring the party leaders to Beijing); Japan will not lend to Beijing before unification; reports from Shanghai on the Constitution and on Beijing's plan of provincial delegates.

reading_review.note: Read as sentences 4 Nov 2026 (Chinese, classical telegraphic): N17, N18, N23, N27, N30 and V4E hold as sentences (Huang Xing's five conditions to Li Yuanhong; Japan will not lend to Beijing before unification; loans through Koike and Aoki); N32, N33 and N35 read in outline, with unresolved names and endings. 555 groups, 96.2% certain or probable, kept read in part as on the Wenmi edition (candidate key, N07 unread): grade B.
